title: KASWASHKABASHA's QOL Modpack
description: A collection of mods featured in one of the comments underneath SalC1's video about the perfect vanilla minecraft setup.
body:
A collection of mods featured in one of the comments underneath SalC1's video about the perfect vanilla minecraft setup. 
see: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pTc09RtJRZY

This modpack aims to include optimizations, quality of life features and some visual enhancements. The mods do not alter the game in any way.
